blocks.zh: Learning Objectives / 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解三種離子輻射模式（γ 射線、電子束、X 射線）的穿透力、劑量率與射源差異
blocks.en: Understand the differences among the three ionizing radiation modalities (gamma rays, electron beam, X-rays) in penetration, dose rate, and radiation source

blocks.zh: 掌握 ISO 11137 劑量設定方法的選擇邏輯與適用情境
blocks.en: Master the selection logic and applicable situations of the ISO 11137 dose-setting methods

blocks.zh: 認識為何輻射滅菌不使用生物指示劑，以及劑量計如何擔任製程控制角色
blocks.en: Recognize why biological indicators are not used in radiation sterilization, and how dosimeters serve as the process control tool

blocks.zh: 將材料相容性評估與劑量分佈圖原則應用於 CDMO 的 RTU 容器與拚棄式組件滅菌情境
blocks.en: Apply the principles of material compatibility assessment and dose mapping to the sterilization of RTU containers and single-use components at a CDMO

blocks.zh: Chapter Contents / 章節總覽
blocks.en: Chapter Contents

blocks.zh: Introduction — 緒論
blocks.en: Introduction

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 輻射滅菌的獨特優勢：與蒸汽滅菌（需要控制溫度、壓力、時間）或濐滅滅菌（需要控制濃度、溫度、濕度、時間）相比，輻射滅菌的控制參數本質上就是一個：吸收劑量（absorbed dose）。這個劑量可以被精確測量，這讓輻射滅菌成為所有滅菌方法中「最可量化」的一種。
blocks.en: The unique advantage of radiation sterilization: Compared with steam sterilization (which requires control of temperature, pressure, and time) or ethylene oxide sterilization (which requires control of concentration, temperature, humidity, and time), radiation sterilization essentially has one control parameter: the absorbed dose. This dose can be measured accurately, which makes radiation the most "quantifiable" of all sterilization methods.

blocks.zh: kGy（千戈瑞）：輻射吸收劑量的國際單位。1 kGy = 1000 J/kg。舊單位 MRad 已不再使用（1 MRad = 10 kGy）。
blocks.en: kGy (kilogray): The SI unit of absorbed radiation dose. 1 kGy = 1000 J/kg. The old unit, the Mrad, is no longer used (1 Mrad = 10 kGy).

blocks.zh: 與 F0 的類比：在蒸汽滅菌中，F0 是衡量製程致死性的核心指標；在輻射滅菌中，kGy 劑量扮演完全相同的角色。兩者都是可測量的物理參數，可直接關聯到微生物殺滅效果。
blocks.en: Analogy to F0: In steam sterilization, F0 is the core measure of process lethality; in radiation sterilization, the dose in kGy plays exactly the same role. Both are measurable physical parameters that can be directly related to microbial kill.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 生物指示劑不適用：這是輻射滅菌與蒸汽滅菌的重大差異。蒸汽滅菌驗證會使用生物指示劑（BI）來確認製程致死性，但輻射滅菌不需要，因為：
blocks.en: Biological indicators are not applicable: This is a major difference between radiation and steam sterilization. Steam sterilization validation uses biological indicators (BIs) to confirm process lethality, but radiation sterilization does not need them, because:

blocks.zh: 劑量計（dosimeters）提供的物理測量比生物系統更可靠、更可重現
blocks.en: Physical measurements from dosimeters are more reliable and more reproducible than biological systems

blocks.zh: 劑量與微生物殺滅之間已有精確的關聯性數據
blocks.en: Precise data already exist correlating dose with microbial kill

blocks.zh: 劑量設定方法基於材料的自然狀態生物負載，而非人工指示菌
blocks.en: Dose-setting methods are based on the natural bioburden of the material, not on artificial indicator organisms

blocks.zh: 參數放行（Parametric Release）：由於劑量測量的高可靠性，輻射滅菌產品可以基於製程參數（而非無菌試驗結果）進行放行。這在 USP 〈1222〉 中有明確描述。
blocks.en: Parametric release: Because dose measurement is highly reliable, radiation-sterilized products can be released on the basis of process parameters rather than sterility test results. This is clearly described in USP <1222>.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Applications

blocks.zh: RTU 容器與拚棄式組件：對於使用預填裝注射筒（PFS）、RTU 瓶、RTU tub 系統的 CDMO，這些組件通常由供應商以輻射滅菌（通常是 gamma）進行最終滅菌。CDMO 需要：
blocks.en: RTU containers and single-use components: For CDMOs that use prefilled syringes (PFS), RTU vials, and RTU tub systems, these components are usually terminally sterilized by the supplier using radiation (usually gamma). The CDMO needs to:

blocks.zh: 驗證供應商的滅菌證書（CoS）是否符合 ISO 11137 要求
blocks.en: Verify that the supplier's certificate of sterility (CoS) meets ISO 11137 requirements

blocks.zh: 確認最小與最大劑量範圍與材料相容性數據
blocks.en: Confirm the minimum and maximum dose range and the material compatibility data

blocks.zh: 在穩定性試驗中納入輻射曝露的影響評估
blocks.en: Include an assessment of the effect of radiation exposure in stability studies

blocks.zh: Gamma Sterilization — γ 射線滅菌
blocks.en: Gamma Sterilization

blocks.zh: Co60 射源：鎅60 是最常用的 gamma 射源。它衰變為鎳60（Ni60）時釋放高能量 gamma 光子。關鍵特性：
blocks.en: Co60 source: Cobalt60 is the most commonly used gamma source. As it decays to nickel60 (Ni60), it emits high-energy gamma photons. Key characteristics:

blocks.zh: 穿透力極強：gamma 射線可穿透厚密包裝和大型棟板貨物，不需解包
blocks.en: Very high penetration: Gamma rays can penetrate thick, dense packaging and large pallet loads without unpacking

blocks.zh: 半衰期 5.27 年：每年大約損失 12% 的放射性，必須定期調整曝露時間或補充射源
blocks.en: Half-life of 5.27 years: Roughly 12% of the radioactivity is lost each year, so exposure time must be adjusted periodically or the source replenished

blocks.zh: 連續照射：物品通過輸送系統繞行射源，接受連續劑量照射
blocks.en: Continuous irradiation: Products travel around the source on a conveyor system and receive a continuous dose

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的意義：大多數 RTU 容器供應商（如 Schott、Gerresheimer、SCHOTT Pharma）使用 gamma 滅菌來處理預填裝玻璃瓶、注射筒和 tub 系統。CDMO 在接收這些組件時，應確認供應商的滅菌證書中包含：實際照射劑量範圍、劑量計類型、及該批次的劑量圖參考資料。
blocks.en: Significance for CDMOs: Most RTU container suppliers (such as Schott, Gerresheimer, and SCHOTT Pharma) use gamma sterilization for prefilled glass vials, syringes, and tub systems. When receiving these components, the CDMO should confirm that the supplier's sterilization certificate includes: the actual irradiation dose range, the dosimeter type, and the dose mapping reference for that batch.

blocks.zh: X-Ray Sterilization — X 射線滅菌
blocks.en: X-Ray Sterilization

blocks.zh: X 射線 vs Gamma：X 射線滅菌生成的光子與 gamma 射線物理特性相似（都是高穿透性光子），但來源完全不同：
blocks.en: X-ray vs gamma: X-ray sterilization generates photons with physical properties similar to gamma rays (both are highly penetrating photons), but the sources are entirely different:

blocks.zh: Gamma：來自放射性同位素 Co60 的核衰變
blocks.en: Gamma: From the nuclear decay of the radioisotope Co60

blocks.zh: X-ray：來自加速電子擊中錦（tantalum）等金屬靶材，是電機產生的
blocks.en: X-ray: From accelerated electrons striking a metal target such as tantalum; it is electrically generated

blocks.zh: 主要優勢：不需要本地放射源，可隨時開關；劑量不會隨時間衰減；可以提供與 gamma 相近的高穿透力。
blocks.en: Main advantages: No on-site radioactive source is needed and the system can be switched on and off at will; the dose does not decay over time; and penetration comparable to gamma can be provided.

blocks.zh: E-Beam Sterilization — 電子束滅菌
blocks.en: E-Beam Sterilization

blocks.zh: 電子束的特色：
blocks.en: Characteristics of electron beam:

blocks.zh: 高劑量率：處理速度極快，產品曝露時間以秒計（gamma 以小時計）
blocks.en: High dose rate: Processing is extremely fast, with product exposure measured in seconds (gamma is measured in hours)

blocks.zh: 低穿透力：電子穿透能力遠低於光子，只適合薄型或低密度物品
blocks.en: Low penetration: Electrons penetrate far less than photons, so the method suits only thin or low-density items

blocks.zh: 溫度效應：高劑量率可能導致材料升溫，需評估熱敏感材料的相容性
blocks.en: Temperature effect: The high dose rate may cause the material to heat up, so the compatibility of heat-sensitive materials must be evaluated

blocks.zh: 無放射源：可由終端使用者自行安裝與操作
blocks.en: No radioactive source: Can be installed and operated by the end user

blocks.zh: 劑量分佈圖更為關鍵：由於電子束穿透力有限，物品密度與幾何形狀的變化會顯著影響劑量分佈。因此，劑量分佈圖（dose mapping）對電子束滅菌而言比 gamma 更加重要。
blocks.en: Dose mapping is even more critical: Because electron beam penetration is limited, variations in item density and geometry significantly affect the dose distribution. Dose mapping is therefore more important for e-beam sterilization than for gamma.

blocks.zh: Three Modalities Comparison — 三種輻射滅菌方式比較
blocks.en: Three Modalities Comparison

blocks.zh: Validation of Radiation Sterilization — 輻射滅菌驗證
blocks.en: Validation of Radiation Sterilization

blocks.zh: 劑量窗口（Dose Window）：輻射滅菌驗證的核心目標是確定一個「劑量窗口」：
blocks.en: Dose window: The core objective of radiation sterilization validation is to establish a "dose window":

blocks.zh: 最小劑量（Dmin）：足以達成目標 SAL（通常 10−6）的最低劑量
blocks.en: Minimum dose (Dmin): The lowest dose sufficient to achieve the target SAL (usually 10−6)

blocks.zh: 最大劑量（Dmax）：材料可承受而不影響品質屬性的最高劑量
blocks.en: Maximum dose (Dmax): The highest dose the material can tolerate without affecting its quality attributes

blocks.zh: D<sub>max</sub> / D<sub>min</sub> 比值越大，製程窗口越寬，操作靈活度越高。
blocks.en: The larger the D<sub>max</sub> / D<sub>min</sub> ratio, the wider the process window and the greater the operating flexibility.

blocks.zh: 選擇劑量設定方法的三個關鍵因素：
blocks.en: Three key factors in choosing a dose-setting method:

blocks.zh: 批次大小：大批量生產適合 Method 1；小批量可考慮 VDmax
blocks.en: Batch size: Large batches suit Method 1; for small batches, consider VDmax

blocks.zh: 生物負載知識：能枝舉生物負載時用 Method 1；不能時用 Method 2
blocks.en: Knowledge of bioburden: Use Method 1 when the bioburden can be enumerated; use Method 2 when it cannot

blocks.zh: 材料對輻射的敏感度：敏感材料需要更精確的劑量控制，適合 Method 1 的精細方法
blocks.en: Radiation sensitivity of the material: Sensitive materials need more precise dose control, which suits the refined approach of Method 1

blocks.zh: Dose Setting — 劑量設定
blocks.en: Dose Setting

blocks.zh: Method 2 的獨特邏輯：Method 2 不直接測定生物負載，而是通過遞增劑量實驗找到「100 個樣品中約 1 個未達無菌」的劑量點。然後從這個點向上外推，計算出能達成 PNSU 10−6 的滅菌劑量。這是一種「由下而上」的方法，與 Method 1 的「從已知生物負載出發」方向相反。
blocks.en: The unique logic of Method 2: Method 2 does not measure bioburden directly. Instead, it uses incremental dose experiments to find the dose at which about 1 in 100 samples is not sterile. From that point, it extrapolates upward to calculate the sterilization dose that achieves a PNSU of 10−6. This is a "bottom-up" approach, the opposite direction from Method 1, which "starts from a known bioburden."

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Dose Setting Methods
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Dose Setting Methods

blocks.zh: 25 kGy 的由來：許多人認為 25 kGy 是「標準」滅菌劑量，但實際上它是基於 VDmax 方法對生物負載 <1000 CFU 的物品所設定的劑量。如果生物負載更低，可能只需要 15 kGy。這不是一個「通用數字」，而是基於特定條件的計算結果。
blocks.en: Where 25 kGy comes from: Many people believe 25 kGy is the "standard" sterilization dose, but it is actually the dose set by the VDmax method for items with a bioburden of <1000 CFU. If the bioburden is lower, 15 kGy may be enough. It is not a "universal number" but the result of a calculation based on specific conditions.

blocks.zh: Material Compatibility — 材料相容性
blocks.en: Material Compatibility

blocks.zh: 材料相容性評估的三個層次：
blocks.en: Three levels of material compatibility assessment:

blocks.zh: 立即效應：照射後立即檢測的變化（外觀、顏色、氣味、機械強度）
blocks.en: Immediate effects: Changes detected right after irradiation (appearance, color, odor, mechanical strength)

blocks.zh: 長期效應：經過儲存後才顯現的變化（脆化、黃變、射出物）
blocks.en: Long-term effects: Changes that appear only after storage (embrittlement, yellowing, release of extractables)

blocks.zh: 安全因子：Dmax 應超過製程中可能出現的最高劑量，加上適當的安全裕量
blocks.en: Safety factor: Dmax should exceed the highest dose that could occur in the process, plus an appropriate safety margin

blocks.zh: RTU 容器與 SUS 組件的材料相容性：
blocks.en: Material compatibility of RTU containers and single-use system (SUS) components:

blocks.zh: 玻璃容器（Type I Borosilicate）：對輻射極為穩定，通常無須擔心材料相容性
blocks.en: Glass containers (Type I borosilicate): Extremely stable to radiation; material compatibility is usually not a concern

blocks.zh: 塑膠組件（如袋膜、管路、連接器）：輻射可能導致高分子鏈段裂（脆化）或交聯（變硬），以及產生可萃取物（E&L）
blocks.en: Plastic components (such as bag films, tubing, and connectors): Radiation may cause polymer chain scission (embrittlement) or crosslinking (hardening), and the generation of extractables (E&L)

blocks.zh: 橡膠塞（stoppers, plungers）：輻射可能影響彈性、密封性與萃取物檢測結果
blocks.en: Rubber closures (stoppers, plungers): Radiation may affect elasticity, sealing performance, and extractables test results

blocks.zh: 藥品本身：如果輻射滅菌應用於最終產品，必須評估藥品穩定性
blocks.en: The drug product itself: If radiation sterilization is applied to the final product, drug product stability must be evaluated

blocks.zh: Dose Verification — 劑量驗證
blocks.en: Dose Verification

blocks.zh: 生物負載方法（Bioburden Approach）：輻射滅菌的劑量設定完全基於產品上的自然微生物汙染，而非人工指示菌。這是因為：
blocks.en: Bioburden approach: Dose setting for radiation sterilization is based entirely on the natural microbial contamination on the product, not on artificial indicator organisms. This is because:

blocks.zh: 輻射對不同微生物的殺滅力已有大量研究數據
blocks.en: Extensive research data already exist on the lethality of radiation against different microorganisms

blocks.zh: 自然生物負載的輻射抗性通常低於指示菌假設值
blocks.en: The radiation resistance of natural bioburden is usually lower than the assumed value for indicator organisms

blocks.zh: 驗證劑量研究會確認這個假設是否成立
blocks.en: The verification dose study confirms whether this assumption holds

blocks.zh: PNSU 10−6：即每百萬個滅菌單位中最多允許一個未達無菌。這與蒸汽滅菌的 SAL 10−6 目標相同。
blocks.en: PNSU 10−6: That is, at most one non-sterile unit is allowed per million sterilized units. This is the same as the SAL 10−6 target for steam sterilization.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: Figure 1 的意義：想像兩座城堡。一座有 1000 個士兵（高生物負載）且皆穿重甲（高輻射抗性），需要強大的攻城部隊（高劑量）。另一座只有 1 個哨兵（低生物負載）且無甲（低抗性），小型巡邏隊（低劑量）即可拿下。這就是為什麼生物負載與抗性共同決定所需的滅菌劑量。
blocks.en: The meaning of Figure 1: Imagine two castles. One has 1000 soldiers (high bioburden), all in heavy armor (high radiation resistance), and needs a powerful siege force (high dose). The other has just 1 sentry (low bioburden) with no armor (low resistance), and a small patrol (low dose) can take it. This is why bioburden and resistance together determine the required sterilization dose.

blocks.zh: Validation Activities — 驗證活動
blocks.en: Validation Activities

blocks.zh: 劑量分佈圖（Dose Mapping）的關鍵輸出：
blocks.en: Key outputs of dose mapping:

blocks.zh: Dmin 位置：放置常規監控劑量計的地方，確認最低劑量達標
blocks.en: Dmin location: Where the routine monitoring dosimeter is placed, to confirm that the minimum dose is achieved

blocks.zh: Dmax 位置：評估材料相容性的基礎，確認最高劑量不超過材料耐受限
blocks.en: Dmax location: The basis for assessing material compatibility, to confirm that the maximum dose does not exceed the material's tolerance limit

blocks.zh: 劑量均勻性比（DUR）：Dmax/Dmin 比值，越接近 1.0 越好，表示劑量分佈均勻
blocks.en: Dose uniformity ratio (DUR): The Dmax/Dmin ratio; the closer to 1.0 the better, indicating a uniform dose distribution

blocks.zh: 劑量計標準體系：ASTM E2628 提供劑量計系統選擇指南；ISO/ASTM 51261 規範校準要求。常用劑量計類型包括丙氨酸劑量計、薄膜劑量計等。
blocks.en: Dosimetry standards: ASTM E2628 provides guidance on selecting dosimetry systems; ISO/ASTM 51261 specifies calibration requirements. Common dosimeter types include alanine dosimeters and film dosimeters.

blocks.zh: 對於接收 RTU tub 與 SUS 組件的 CDMO：雖然滅菌由供應商執行，但 CDMO 應確認供應商的驗證文件包括：
blocks.en: For CDMOs receiving RTU tubs and SUS components: Although sterilization is performed by the supplier, the CDMO should confirm that the supplier's validation documents include:

blocks.zh: 完整的劑量分佈圖數據與 DUR 值
blocks.en: Complete dose mapping data and DUR values

blocks.zh: 劑量計校準記錄與可追溯性
blocks.en: Dosimeter calibration records and traceability

blocks.zh: 批次放行證明上的實際照射劑量範圍
blocks.en: The actual irradiation dose range on the batch release certificate

blocks.zh: 生物負載監控與定期劑量審計記錄
blocks.en: Bioburden monitoring and periodic dose audit records

blocks.zh: Routine Process Control — 常規製程控制
blocks.en: Routine Process Control

blocks.zh: 維持驗證狀態的七大實務：
blocks.en: Seven practices for maintaining the validated state:

blocks.zh: Training 培訓：操作人員能力確認與持續教育
blocks.en: Training: Confirmation of operator competence and continuing education

blocks.zh: Calibration 校準：劑量計與相關儀器的定期校準
blocks.en: Calibration: Periodic calibration of dosimeters and related instruments

blocks.zh: Physical Measurements 物理測量：製程參數的常規記錄與審查
blocks.en: Physical measurements: Routine recording and review of process parameters

blocks.zh: Bioburden Monitoring 生物負載監控：定期確認產品的預滅菌微生物水平未超出劑量設定假設
blocks.en: Bioburden monitoring: Regular confirmation that the pre-sterilization microbial level of the product does not exceed the assumptions used in dose setting

blocks.zh: Change Control 變更控制：任何裝載配置、材料或製程變更的管理
blocks.en: Change control: Management of any change in load configuration, materials, or process

blocks.zh: Preventive Maintenance 預防性維護：設備的定期維護計畫
blocks.en: Preventive maintenance: A planned program of periodic equipment maintenance

blocks.zh: Periodic Dose Audits 定期劑量審計：通常每季或每年重新驗證劑量設定是否仍然有效
blocks.en: Periodic dose audits: Usually quarterly or annually, to reconfirm that the dose setting remains valid

blocks.zh: 與 USP 〈1229〉 的關係：USP 〈1229.10〉 是 USP 〈1229〉（General Principles of Sterilization）的子章節。〈1229〉 提供所有滅菌方法的通用原則，而 〈1229.10〉 專門針對輻射滅菌。其他子章包括：
blocks.en: Relationship to USP <1229>: USP <1229.10> is a subchapter of USP <1229> (General Principles of Sterilization). <1229> provides general principles for all sterilization methods, while <1229.10> addresses radiation sterilization specifically. Other subchapters include:

blocks.zh: Chapter Summary / 全章重點回顧
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: Radiation Sterilization uses ionizing radiation (gamma, e-beam, X-ray) to destroy microorganisms; control is based on the precisely measurable absorbed dose (kGy), making it the most quantifiable sterilization method / 輻射滅菌以吸收劑量為唯一控制參數，精確可測量，是最可量化的滅菌方法
blocks.en: Radiation Sterilization uses ionizing radiation (gamma, e-beam, X-ray) to destroy microorganisms; control is based on the precisely measurable absorbed dose (kGy), making it the most quantifiable sterilization method

blocks.zh: Three modalities offer different trade-offs: gamma (high penetration, isotope source), X-ray (high penetration, electrical), e-beam (highest dose rate, limited penetration) / 三種方式各有優勢：gamma 高穿透、X-ray 無放射源、e-beam 極快速度
blocks.en: Three modalities offer different trade-offs: gamma (high penetration, isotope source), X-ray (high penetration, electrical), e-beam (highest dose rate, limited penetration)

blocks.zh: Dose setting follows ISO 11137 methods (1, 2A, 2B, VDmax), chosen based on batch size, bioburden knowledge, and material sensitivity / 劑量設定依據 ISO 11137 方法，需考慮批量大小、生物負載與材料敏感度
blocks.en: Dose setting follows ISO 11137 methods (1, 2A, 2B, VDmax), chosen based on batch size, bioburden knowledge, and material sensitivity

blocks.zh: Biological indicators are not used — dosimetry provides more reliable, reproducible process control than biological systems / 不使用生物指示劑，劑量計提供更可靠的製程控制
blocks.en: Biological indicators are not used — dosimetry provides more reliable, reproducible process control than biological systems

blocks.zh: Material compatibility must assess both immediate and long-term radiation effects on drug product and primary container / 材料相容性需評估立即與長期輻射效應，含藥品與主要容器
blocks.en: Material compatibility must assess both immediate and long-term radiation effects on drug product and primary container

blocks.zh: Dose mapping identifies Dmin and Dmax locations for routine monitoring; the dose uniformity ratio (DUR) characterizes load configuration quality / 劑量分佈圖確定 Dmin、Dmax 位置與劑量均勻性
blocks.en: Dose mapping identifies Dmin and Dmax locations for routine monitoring; the dose uniformity ratio (DUR, Dmax/Dmin) characterizes load configuration quality

blocks.zh: Routine control requires training, calibration, bioburden monitoring, change control, preventive maintenance, and periodic dose audits / 常規控制需含培訓、校準、生物負載監控、變更控制、預防維護與定期劑量審計
blocks.en: Routine control requires training, calibration, bioburden monitoring, change control, preventive maintenance, and periodic dose audits

blocks.zh: CDMO relevance: RTU tubs and SUS components are typically gamma-sterilized by suppliers; CDMO must verify supplier certificates, dose ranges, and material compatibility data / CDMO 應驗證供應商的輻射滅菌證書、劑量範圍與材料相容性數據
blocks.en: CDMO relevance: RTU tubs and SUS components are typically gamma-sterilized by suppliers; CDMO must verify supplier certificates, dose ranges, and material compatibility data
